description: This header file defines the interface for accelerometer hardware interaction, including configuration, initialization, and data retrieval functions related to acceleration and turns.

methods.name: configureAccelerometerPins
methods.description: Configures the pins used by the accelerometer hardware.

methods.name: getLongitudinalAcceleration
methods.description: Retrieves the acceleration in the longitudinal direction.

methods.name: getTransverseAcceleration
methods.description: Retrieves the acceleration in the transverse direction.
